title: Market intelligence company Klue confirms it has suffered a breach, for which cybercrime group Icarus takes credit; Jamf, HackerOne, and others are affected (Zack Whittaker/TechCrunch)
summary: Zack Whittaker / TechCrunch: Market intelligence company Klue confirms it has suffered a breach, for which cybercrime group Icarus takes credit; Jamf, HackerOne, and others are affected — A hacking group has taken credit for a breach at market intelligence provider Klue that allowed hackers to steal reams of data …
